lines.text: Applications, assessments, recruiter emails, and interviews disappear into different threads.
Opportunity Inbox turns those emails into one live recruiting workspace.
follow every opportunity from application to interview to offer,
and rebuild each company into one clean history.
No spreadsheets. No digging through Gmail.
